summary: Walks a linked chain of reference-counted resources rooted at the head pointer in this[9] (this+0x24), releasing each node via ReferenceCountedResourceRelease. The walk continues while that call returns anything other than -1, advancing through each node's next pointer at +0xC0. Returns 0 when the list is empty or the chain ends normally, and -1 when a release returns -1.

operations.description: Load head pointer into v1 from this[9] (dword at byte offset 0x24).
If head pointer is null, return 0 (no chain to release).
While ReferenceCountedResourceRelease(current_node) != -1, keep releasing nodes and advancing through each node's next pointer at +0xC0.
Call ReferenceCountedResourceRelease(v1) on the current node; a return of -1 exits the loop.
Advance v1 to the next node read from the current node's +0xC0 pointer.
If the next node pointer is null, return 0 (chain ended normally).
Return -1 after a release call that returned -1, signalling the early exit condition.

unresolved: What a -1 return from ReferenceCountedResourceRelease means (refcount failure vs sentinel) is unproven.
Whether the head this+0x24 and next-pointer +0xC0 layout matches the sibling 005487a0 walker is DERIVED from identical offsets only.
